harrat-mujtaba:115-115.t: «صدقا»: a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial). The preposition «لكلماته» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «لا», the lā of generic negation. The clause «لا مبدِّل لكلماته» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «تمت», and the link between the ḥāl and the one it describes is achieved by the overt noun; the original is: لا مبدِّل لها. The clause «وهو السميع» is resumptive, and «العليم» is a second khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:116-116.t: «إن يتبعون»: «إن» is negating, and an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ); «الظن» is the object; the clause is resumptive. The clause «يخرصون» is in the position of the nominative as a khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:117-117.t: «هو»: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, and «أعلم» is the khabar (predicate) of inna. The relative noun «مَن» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied (muqaddar) verb, i.e. يعلم مَن. The clause «وهو أعلم» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «إن ربك».

harrat-mujtaba:118-118.t: The clause «فكلوا» is resumptive, and the clause «إن كنتم» is resumptive; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:119-119.t: His words «وما لكم»: the wāw is a conjunction; «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The interpreted maṣdar «ألا تأكلوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition (في), i.e. "what thing has settled in preventing eating?" The clause «وقد فصَّل لكم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «تأكلوا». «ما» in his words «اضطررتم» is a relative noun, excepted, in the position of the accusative. The clause «وإن كثيرا ليضلون» is resumptive, and the preposition «بغير» is attached to a ḥāl from the wāw in «يضلون». The clause «إن ربك هو أعلم» is resumptive, and the clause «هو أعلم» is the khabar of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:120-120.t: The clause «إن الذين يكسبون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:121-121.t: The clause «وإنه لفسق» is conjoined to the clause «لا تأكلوا», with no grammatical position; conjoining a statement (khabar) to a performative (inshāʾ) is valid. The lām in «ليوحون» is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). The clause «وإن أطعتموهم» is conjoined to the clause «إن الشياطين ليوحون». The clause «إنكم لمشركون» is the answer to an implied oath, on the reading of «إنْ» as «لئن»; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath, and the lām that prepares for the oath's answer (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa) was dropped.

harrat-mujtaba:122-122.t: (أومن كان ميتا فأحييناه) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The hamza is for interrogation, and the wāw is resumptive. «مَن» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition «كمن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «مَن», i.e. "being like the one who". The clause «ليس بخارج» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun «مَن». The clause «زُيِّن» is resumptive, and the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "it was made fair-seeming to the disbelievers with a making-fair like that making-fair"; the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:123-123.t: «أكابر»: the first object of «جعلنا», and the preposition «في كل قرية» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object. The clause «وما يمكرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «يمكروا», and the clause «وما يشعرون» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «يمكرون».

harrat-mujtaba:124-124.t: His words «الله أعلم»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). «حيث» has left its adverbial function and become a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa); what governs it is a verb indicated by «أعلم». It is not an adverb, because He the Exalted is not more knowing in one place than in another place; the implied form is: "He knows the place fit for placing His message". «صَغَار» is the fāʿil (agent), and the interpreted maṣdar «بما كانوا» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يصيب».

harrat-mujtaba:125-125.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن يهديه» is the object of «يُرد». «حرجا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) multiplied: just as an explicit khabar (predicate) may be multiple, so may what was originally such. The clause «كأنما يصَّعَّد» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «حرجا»; «كأنما» is a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa), with no governing effect. The clause «يجعل» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:126-126.t: «مستقيما»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «صراط». The clause «قد فَصَّلنا» is resumptive. The clause «يذَّكرون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوم».

harrat-mujtaba:127-127.t: The clause «لهم دار السلام» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «يذكرون», and likewise the clause «وهو وليهم».

harrat-mujtaba:128-128.t: The adverb «يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied (muqaddar) «يقول», and the implied clause «يقول» is resumptive. «جميعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «يحشرهم». The clause «وقال» is conjoined to the implied one. The relative clause «الذي أجَّلتَ» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أجلنا». «خالدين» is a ḥāl from the pronoun in «مثواكم». «إلا» is for exception, and «ما» is the excepted, connected (muttaṣil).

harrat-mujtaba:129-129.t: (وكذلك نولي بعض الظالمين بعضا) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «بعضا» is the second object. The clause «نولِّي» is resumptive, and the clause «كانوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative.

harrat-mujtaba:130-130.t: The clause «ألم يأتكم» is the answer to the vocative, resumptive. The clause «يقصُّون» is a second naʿt (adjective) of «رسل». «لقاء» is the second object of أنذر. «هذا» is a naʿt of «يومكم». The interpreted maṣdar «أنهم كانوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:131-131.t: «ذا»: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the khabar (predicate) is implied (muqaddar), i.e. "the matter". «أنْ» is lightened from the heavy (inna), and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), its implied form being: أنه. The interpreted maṣdar is accusative by removal of the preposition, the lām, i.e. "that matter which We related is because it was not...". The preposition «بظلم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «مهلك», i.e. "involved in wrongdoing". The clause «وأهلها غافلون» is a ḥāl from «القرى», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:132-132.t: The preposition «مما عملوا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «درجات». The clause «وما ربك بغافل» is conjoined to the resumptive clause at the start of the verse; «ما» is Ḥijāzī, and the bāʾ in its khabar (predicate) is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:133-133.t: «ذو»: a second khabar (predicate). The conditional clause is resumptive. «يذهبكم» became transitive through the entry of the hamza of transitivity on its past form «أَذْهَبَ». The kāf in «كما» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "He will cause to succeed with a causing-to-succeed like His bringing you into being"; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «يشاء» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the noun relative, and the clause «أنشأكم» is the ṣila of the particle relative.

harrat-mujtaba:134-134.t: «إن», its noun and its khabar (predicate), and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). The clause «وما أنتم بمعجزين» is conjoined to the resumptive clause at the start of the verse, and the bāʾ in the khabar of «ما» is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:135-135.t: The clause «إني عامل» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and likewise the clause «فسوف تعلمون» is resumptive. «مَنْ» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the preposition «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of kāna.

harrat-mujtaba:136-136.t: The preposition «لله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «جعلوا», and the first is «نصيبا». «من الحرث»: this preposition phrase is a badal (substitute) from «مما ذرأ», attached to what it is attached to; the first is attached to «جعلوا». The preposition «بزعمهم» is attached to «قالوا». «ما» in his words «فما كان» is conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject). The fāʾ in «فلا يصل» links the apodosis, and it entered upon an omitted detached pronoun, the implied form being: فهو لا يصل. The clause «فما كان» is conjoined to the clause «فقالوا». The clause «ساء ما يحكمون» is resumptive; «ما» is a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent) of «ساء», and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. "their judgement".

harrat-mujtaba:137-137.t: (وكذلك زين لكثير من المشركين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "he made fair-seeming with a making-fair like that making-fair". His words «شركاؤهم»: the fāʿil (agent) of the verb (زيَّن), and the interpreted maṣdar «ليردوهم» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «زيَّن». The conditional clause «ولو شاء الله ما فعلوه» is conjoined to the clause «زيَّن», and the clause «فذَرْهم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:138-138.t: «مَنْ نشاء»: a relative noun, fāʿil (agent). The preposition «بزعمهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of «قالوا». His words «أنعام حرمت»: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "and these are cattle"; the clause «حُرِّمت» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أنعام». His words «وأنعام لا يذكرون»: a khabar, i.e. "and these are cattle", and the clause «لا يذكرون» is a naʿt of أنعام. «افتراء» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), and the preposition is attached to a naʿt of «افتراء». The clause «سيجزيهم» is resumptive, and the interpreted maṣdar «بما كانوا» is genitive, attached to «يجزيهم».

harrat-mujtaba:139-139.t: «ما»: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «خالصة» is its khabar (predicate). The preposition «في بطون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause). His words «ومحرم»: conjoined to «خالصة». The clause «وإن يكن ميتة» is conjoined to the clause that is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). The clause «سيجزيهم وصفهم» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «إنه حكيم عليم»; «وعليم» is a second khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:140-140.t: «سَفَهًا»: a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). The preposition «بغير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «قتلوا». «افتراء» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi. The clause «قد ضلُّوا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:141-141.t: His words «وغير»: conjoined to «معروشات». «مختلفا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «النخل»; «أكله» is the fāʿil (agent) of مختلف. «متشابها» is a ḥāl from «الرُّمَّان». His words «إذا أثمر»: conditional and adverbial, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the content of the implied (muqaddar) apodosis, i.e. "when it bears fruit, then eat"; the clause «أثمر» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The conditional clause «إذا أثمر فكلوا» is resumptive, and the clause «إنه لا يحب» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:142-142.t: The preposition «من الأنعام» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied (muqaddar) verb, i.e. أنشأ; «حمولة» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the implied verb أنشأ. The implied clause (وأنشأ) is conjoined to the earlier verb «أنشأ». The clause «كلوا» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «إنه عدو».

harrat-mujtaba:143-143.t: «ثمانية»: a badal (substitute) from «حمولة». The preposition «من الضأن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «اثنين», and «اثنين» is a badal from «ثمانية», and likewise what comes after it. «الذَّكَرَيْن» is an object placed before «حرَّم»; «أم» is a conjunction, and «الأنْثيين» is conjoined to «الذَّكرين», accusative with yāʾ. His words «أم ما اشتملت»: «أم» is a conjunction, and «ما» is a relative noun conjoined to «الأنْثيين». The clause «إن كنتم صادقين» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:144-144.t: His words «ومن الإبل اثنين»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition phrase is conjoined to the preposition phrase «من الضأن»; «واثنين» is conjoined to «الضأن» [Translator's note: so in the source; presumably meant: to «اثنين» of verse 143], and likewise its counterpart that follows. «أم» in his words «أم كنتم» is disconnected (munqaṭiʿa), and the clause after it is resumptive. His words «إذ»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شهداء». The clause «فمن أظلم» is resumptive; «مَن» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أظلم» is its khabar (predicate); the preposition is attached to «أظلم», and the interpreted maṣdar «ليضل» is genitive, attached to «افترى».

harrat-mujtaba:145-145.t: «محرما»: the object of «أجد», and the preposition «على طاعم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «محرما». The interpreted maṣdar «أن يكون» is excepted, disconnected (munqaṭiʿ). The fāʾ in «فإنه رجس» is parenthetical, and so is the clause. His words «أو فسقا»: conjoined to «لحم», and the clause «أُهِلَّ» is a naʿt (adjective) of «فسقا». The clause «فمن اضطر» is resumptive. «غير» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) in «اضطر»; «لا» is redundant (zāʾida), and «عادٍ» is a noun conjoined to «باغ».

harrat-mujtaba:146-146.t: The clause «حرَّمنا» is resumptive, and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «حرَّمنا»; the second «حرَّمنا» is conjoined to the first. «إلا» is for exception, and «ما» is a relative noun, excepted. The clause «ذلك جزيناهم» is resumptive; the bāʾ in «ببغيهم» is causal, and the clause «وإنَّا لصادقون» is conjoined to the verbal clause «جزيناهم».

harrat-mujtaba:147-147.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. The clause «ولا يُرَدُّ» is conjoined to the single word (mufrad) «ذو رحمة».

harrat-mujtaba:148-148.t: His words «ولا آباؤنا»: conjoined to the nominative pronoun «نا»; what permitted conjoining an overt noun to the pronoun is the presence of a separator, namely the negating particle. «شيء» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). The kāf in «كذلك» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "those before them denied with a denial like that denial", and the clause «كذَّب» is resumptive. «عِلْم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «مِن» is redundant, and the adverb «عندكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The fāʾ in «فتخرجوه» is causal, and the verb is accusative by أن necessarily concealed; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e. "is there any knowledge with you, and so its bringing forth to us?" «إن» is negating and «إلا» is a particle of restriction; the clause «إن تتبعون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:149-149.t: His words «فلله»: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition, i.e. "so if the matter is as you claimed". The conditional clause after it, «فلو شاء», is conjoined to the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). «أجمعين» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the kāf in «هداكم».

harrat-mujtaba:150-150.t: «هلمَّ»: a verbal noun (ism fiʿl) meaning "bring". The interpreted maṣdar «أن الله حرم» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ. The clause «فإن شهدوا» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «قل». The clause «وهم يعدلون» is conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause), as a case of conjoining a nominal clause to a verbal one.

harrat-mujtaba:151-151.t: «تعالوا»: an inflexible (jāmid) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn. «أتل» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), occurring as the apodosis of an implied (muqaddar) condition; «أن» after it is explicative, and the clause «لا تشركوا» is explicative. The preposition «بالوالدين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied verb «أحسنوا», and «إحسانا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the implied clause «أحسنوا» is conjoined to «لا تشركوا». The clause «نحن نرزقهم» is parenthetical, with no grammatical position. His words «إياهم»: a detached accusative pronoun conjoined to the kāf in «نرزقكم». His words «ما ظهر»: a relative noun, a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from «الفواحش». The preposition «بالحق» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «تقتلوا». The clause «ذلكم وصَّاكم» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «لعلكم تعقلون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:152-152.t: The preposition «بالقسط» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object. The clause «لا نكلف نفسا» is parenthetical, and «وسعها» is a second object. The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause «أوفوا». The wāw in «ولو كان» is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), conjoining to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "be just in every state, even in this state"; this is for exhausting all the states. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The noun of kāna is implied, "he", referring to the one spoken about. The clause «ذلكم وصَّاكم» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «لعلكم تذكَّرون».

harrat-mujtaba:153-153.t: The interpreted maṣdar «وأن هذا صراطي» is the object of an omitted verb, its implied form being: "I recite to you", and the implied clause is conjoined to «أتل» in verse 151. «مستقيما»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «صراطي», accusative. The clause «فاتبعوه» is conjoined to the clause «وأن هذا صراطي». The fāʾ in «فتفرَّق» is causal, and the verb is accusative by a concealed أن; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e. "let there not be from you a following of the paths, and so a scattering". The clause «ذلكم وصَّاكم» is resumptive, and likewise «لعلكم تتقون».

harrat-mujtaba:154-154.t: «تماما»: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "We completed a completing", and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «تماما». The clause «لعلهم يؤمنون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:155-155.t: The clause «أنزلناه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «كتاب», and «مبارك» is a second naʿt. The clause «فاتبعوه» is conjoined to the clause «وهذا كتاب». The clause «لعلكم ترحمون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:156-156.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن تقولوا» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "out of aversion", and what governs it is an implied (muqaddar) «أنزلناه», not the one actually uttered, so that the governor and what it governs are not separated by an extraneous element, namely «مبارك». The preposition «من قبلنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «طائفتين». «إنْ» is lightened from the heavy (inna) and inoperative, and the lām with it is the distinguishing lām (al-fāriqa) between it and the negating إن. «غافلين» is the khabar (predicate) of «كنا». The clause «وإن كنا» is conjoined to the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:157-157.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أَنَّا أُنزلَ» is the fāʿil (agent) of an implied (muqaddar) «ثبت», i.e. "if a sending down were established". The clause «فقد جاءكم» is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you are truthful, then there has come to you". The preposition «من ربكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of «بيِّنة». The clause «فمن أظلم» is resumptive, made up of a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). The clause «سنجزي» is resumptive, and the interpreted maṣdar «بما كانوا» is genitive by the bāʾ, attached to «نجزي».

harrat-mujtaba:158-158.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن تأتيهم» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «نفسا» is an object, and «إيمانها» is a fāʿil (agent) placed later. The clause «لا ينفع» is resumptive, and the clause «لم تكن» is a naʿt (adjective) of «نفسا». «خيرا» is the mafʿūl bihi of «كسبت». The clause «قل» is resumptive. The clause «إنا منتظرون» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:159-159.t: The preposition «في شيء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the notion of being settled (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached. The clause «إنما أمرهم إلى الله» is resumptive, and the clause «ينبئهم» is conjoined to the resumptive clause. The relative «بما كانوا» is genitive, attached to «ينبئهم».

harrat-mujtaba:160-160.t: «مَن»: a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «جاء» is the khabar (predicate). The clause «فلا يُجْزَى» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), on the implied form فهو لا يُجزى; the clause «يُجزى» is the khabar of the implied mubtadaʾ. The nominal clause «وهم لا يظلمون» is conjoined to the apodosis.

harrat-mujtaba:161-161.t: «دينا»: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb «الزموا», concealed; «قيما» is a naʿt (adjective), «ملة» is a badal (substitute) from «دينا», and «حنيفا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «إبراهيم». A ḥāl from the muḍāf ilayhi is permitted because the muḍāf ilayhi is like a part of the muḍāf. The clause «وما كان» is conjoined to the wording of the ḥāl «حنيفا», as a case of conjoining a clause to a single word.

harrat-mujtaba:162-162.t: The preposition «لله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of inna. «رب» is a badal (substitute), genitive.

harrat-mujtaba:163-163.t: The clause «لا شريك له» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «رب العالمين». The clause «أُمرت» is resumptive, and the clause «وأنا أول» is conjoined to the resumptive clause, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:164-164.t: «غير»: an object placed before «أبغي», and «ربا» is a tamyīz (specification). The clause «وهو رب» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the Divine Name. «إلا» is for restriction; the preposition «عليها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl from the omitted object, i.e. "no soul earns a sin except as being thrown back upon it". The clause «ثم إلى ربكم مرجعكم» is conjoined to the clause «لا تَزِرُ», and the clause «ينبئكم» is conjoined to the nominal clause «ثم إلى ربكم مرجعكم».

harrat-mujtaba:165-165.t: «درجات»: a second object, on «رفع» being made to imply (taḍmīn) the meaning of بَلَّغَ (to make reach). The interpreted maṣdar «ليبلوكم» is genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) رفع. The clause «إن ربك سريع العقاب» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: The clause «ثم الذين كفروا بربهم يعدلون» is conjoined to the initial clause «الحمد لله». The preposition phrase «بربهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يعدلون».

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The clause «وأجل مسمى عنده» is conjoined to the clause «قضى أجلا», with no grammatical position; beginning with the indefinite noun «أجل» is permitted because it is qualified. The clause «ثم أنتم تمترون» is conjoined to the clause «هو الذي خلقكم».

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The preposition phrase «في السماوات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the Divine Name, because of the meaning of "the One worshipped" that it contains. The clause «يعلم» is a second khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «هو».

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «من آية» is the fāʿil (agent), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); a past verb may occur after «إلا» because it comes after a verb; and the clause «كانوا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of «تأتيهم».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The clause «فقد كذبوا» is resumptive, and the clause «لما جاءهم» is parenthetical between the conjoined items, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) being omitted, what precedes indicating it; the clause «فسوف يأتيهم» is conjoined to the clause «فقد كذبوا».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: «كم» is predicative (khabariyya), a fronted object, and the preposition phrase «من قرن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective (ṣifa) of «كم»; the clause «أهلكنا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «يروا», «كم» having suspended the seeing from operating. The clause «مكنَّاهم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قرن», and the pronoun refers back to it in the plural according to its meaning. His saying «ما لم نمكن لكم»: «ما» is an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, i.e.: a thing that We did not establish for you, in the position of the accusative as a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the clause «لم نمكن» is an adjective of the implied «شيئًا». «مدرارًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «السماء», and the clause «فأهلكناهم» is conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, i.e.: they disbelieved, so We destroyed them.

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The preposition phrase «في قرطاس» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كتابًا»; «إن» is negating; «هذا سحر» are mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); and «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr).

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The clause «ولو أنزلنا ملكًا» is resumptive, and the clause «لا ينظرون» is conjoined to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: His saying «للبسنا عليهم»: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is for strengthening the link, and «ما» is a relative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «ولقد استهزئ برسل» is resumptive, and the clause «لقد استهزئ» is the reply to the oath, with no grammatical position. «ما» in His saying «ما كانوا» is a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent) of «حاق», and the clause «فحاق» is conjoined to the clause «استهزئ», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The preposition phrase «في السماوات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause). The preposition phrase «لله» is attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: it belongs to Allah. The clause «كتب» is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the clause «(والله) ليجمعنَّكم» is resumptive, and the clause «ليجمعنكم» is the reply to the oath; the clause «لا ريب فيه» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «يوم القيامة», in the position of the accusative. His saying «الذين خسروا»: mubtadaʾ, and the clause «فهم لا يؤمنون» is the khabar; the redundant fāʾ may be attached to the khabar because the relative is likened to the conditional.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The clause «وله ما سكن» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause «وهو السميع» is conjoined to the resumptive one.

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: «غير» is the first object of «أتخذ», «وليًا» is the second object, and «فاطر» is a badal (substitute) of the Divine Name, even though a badal from derived words is uncommon. The clause «وهو يطعم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), in the position of the accusative, of the Divine Name. The interpreted maṣdar «أن أكون» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ. His saying «من أسلم»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «ولا تكونن» is conjoined to the clause «قل», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The clause «إن عصيت ربي» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e.: if I disobeyed Him, punishment would befall me.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: «يومئذ» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يُصْرَف»; «إذٍ» is an adverbial noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and its tanwīn is in compensation for a clause. The clause «وذلك الفوز» is resumptive; it is a nominal clause of mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: His saying «فلا كاشف»: the fāʾ is linking; [«لا» is] the lā of generic negation and [«كاشف» is] its noun; the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate); «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); and «هو» is a badal (substitute) of the latent pronoun in the omitted khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: «فوق» is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second khabar (predicate), and «الخبير» is a second khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: «أَيُّ»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is «أكبر», and «شهادة» is tamyīz (specification). The adverb «بيني» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شهيد», and the clause «وأوحي إليَّ هذا القرآن» is conjoined to the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl). His saying «مَنْ بلغ»: a relative noun conjoined to the kāf. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن مع الله آلهة» is accusative by removal of the preposition (the bāʾ), and «مع» is an adverb of place attached to the khabar. The clause «أئنكم لتشهدون» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «قل لا أشهد»; the preposition phrase «مما تشركون» is attached to «بريء»; and the clause «وإنني بريء» is conjoined to the content of what is said.

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The clause «يعرفونه» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين»; the kāf in «كما» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya, i.e.: they know him with a knowing like the knowing of their sons; and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «فهم لا يؤمنون» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين», the fāʾ being joined to the khabar because the relative is likened to the conditional.

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: (ومن أظلم ممن افترى) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is resumptive; «مَنْ» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أظلم» is its khabar (predicate); the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أظلم»; and the hāʾ in «إنه» is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and its clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: His saying «ويوم»: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied «اتقوا» (beware), and the clause «اتقوا» is resumptive; «جميعًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun «هم»; «أين» is an interrogative noun, an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied khabar (predicate); «شركاؤكم» is mubtadaʾ (subject); and «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن قالوا» is the khabar (predicate) of «كان»; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); «ربنا» is a badal (substitute) of the Divine Name; the clause «لم تكن فتنتهم» is conjoined to the clause «نقول»; and the clause «ما كنا» is the reply to the oath, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: «كيف كَذَبوا» is a clause in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb «انظر», which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative. «ما» is the fāʿil (agent) of «ضل», and the clause «ضلَّ» is conjoined to the clause «كذبوا».

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The clause «وجعلنا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the relative; the ḥāl-wāw may be joined to a past verb. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يفقهوه» is mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: out of dislike. The preposition phrase «في آذانهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of «وَقْرًا», and «وقرًا» is conjoined to «أكنَّة». «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya), and the conditional clause after it is resumptive; the clause «يجادلونك» is a ḥāl of the wāw in «جاءوك», and the clause «يقول» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The clause «وإن يهلكون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «ينأون», «إن» being negating; and the clause «وما يشعرون» is a ḥāl of the wāw in «يهلكون», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: (ولو ترى إذ وقفوا على النار) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e.: you would see something terrible; the clause «وُقِفوا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The wāw in His saying «ولا نكذب» is for accompaniment (maʿiyya), and the verb is accusative by «أن» necessarily concealed after it; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: would that there were for us a return and an absence of denial; and the clause «نكذِّب» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī), with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The clause «بل بدا ما كانوا» is resumptive; the conditional clause is conjoined to the resumptive one; and the clause «وإنهم لكاذبون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: (إن هي إلا حياتنا الدنيا) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] «إن» is negating, without governing effect (muhmala), and the clause «وما نحن بمبعوثين» is conjoined to the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: (ولو ترى إذ وقفوا على ربهم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e.: you would see something terrible. The clause «قال» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the reply to the oath is implied, i.e.: yes, by Allah, it is indeed the truth. The clause «ولو ترى» is conjoined to the clause «لو ترى» in verse (27). The fāʾ in His saying «فذوقوا» links to the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if you have disbelieved, then taste; the implied conditional clause and its apodosis are the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative, and the clause «فذوقوا» is the apodosis, in the position of the jussive.

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya); «إذا» is an adverbial conditional attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قالوا»; and the clause is resumptive. «بغتة» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause «وهم يحملون أوزارهم» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «قالوا». His saying «ألا ساء ما يزرون»: «ألا» is a particle of opening and drawing attention, [«ساء» is] a past verb, and the relative is its fāʿil; the one specified for blame is omitted, i.e.: that burden of theirs; and the clause of blame is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: His saying «وللدار»: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is for emphasis, and [then come] mubtadaʾ (subject), its naʿt (adjective) and its khabar (predicate). The clause is conjoined to the resumptive one, and the clause «أفلا تعقلون» is resumptive; the hamza is placed first because it has the right to the head of the clause (al-ṣadāra).

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The hamza of «إن» is given a kasra because of the presence of the lām in the khabar (predicate), and the clause «إنه ليحزنك» stands in place of the two objects of «نعلم». The relative «الذي» is the fāʿil (agent) of «يحزن». The clause «فإنهم لا يكذبونك» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause «ولكن الظالمين يجحدون» is conjoined to the clause «فإنهم لا يكذبونك». The preposition phrase «بآيات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يجحدون».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The preposition phrase «من قبلك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رسل». The clause «ولا مبدِّل لكلمات الله» is resumptive, and the clause «ولقد جاءك» is resumptive. The fāʿil (agent) of «جاءك» is implied, i.e.: the news; the preposition phrase «من نبإ» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied «الخبر»; and «المرسلين» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: (وإن كان كبر عليك إعراضهم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is resumptive, and the noun of «كان» is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); the clause «كبر إعراضهم» is in the position of the accusative as khabar (predicate) of «كان». The clause «فإن استطعت», together with the implied apodosis, is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the first condition «إن كان», and the apodosis of «إن استطعت» is implied, i.e.: then do so. The clause «ولو شاء الله» is conjoined to the clause «إن كان كبر», with no grammatical position. The clause «فلا تكونن» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The clause «والموتى يبعثهم الله» is conjoined to the resumptive one. The clause «يرجعون» is conjoined to the clause «يبعثهم», in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), and the preposition phrase «من ربه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «آية». The interpreted maṣdar «على أن ينزل» is genitive, attached to «قادر». The clause «ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون» is conjoined to the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: «دابة» is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the «من» before it is redundant (zāʾida); the preposition phrase «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «دابة»; «طائر» is conjoined to «دابة»; and the clause «يطير» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «طائر», in the position of the nominative. His saying «أمم»: the khabar (predicate) of «دابة»; His saying «أمثالكم»: a naʿt, and it is indefinite, not acquiring definiteness from its annexation because it is vague. His saying «من شيء»: a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), «من» being redundant, i.e.: any neglect. The clause «يحشرون» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «ما من دابة إلا أمم», and the clause «ما فرطنا..» is parenthetical between the conjoined items.

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: His saying «صم»: the khabar (predicate) of the relative, and the preposition phrase «في الظلمات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject). The conditional clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «من» is conditional, mubtadaʾ, and the clause «يضلله» is the khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: His saying «أرأيتكم»: the hamza is for the interrogative, [followed by] a past verb and the fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is a particle of address; the first object is omitted, i.e.: have you considered the punishment of Allah? The clause «إن أتاكم» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e.: then tell me about it. «غير» is a fronted object, and the clause «تدعون» is the second object of «رأيتكم»; the link of the clause «تدعون» to the first object is omitted, i.e.: is it other than Allah that you call upon to remove it? The implied form is: Say: have you considered the punishment of Allah, if it came to you, or the Hour, if it came to you — is it other than Allah that you would call upon to remove it? «أرأيتكم» and the conditional verb «أتاكم» contend (tanāzuʿ) for «عذاب», and the second, «أتاكم», is given the governing role. The apodosis of «إن كنتم» is omitted, what precedes indicating it.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: «إياه»: a detached accusative pronoun, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is a particle of the absent [third person]. The clause «تدعون» is resumptive, and the clause «إن شاء» is parenthetical, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) being omitted, what precedes indicating it, i.e.: if He wills to remove, He removes. The clause «وتنسون» is conjoined to the clause «يكشف», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The clause «ولقد أرسلنا إلى أمم» is resumptive, and the clause «لقد أرسلنا» is the reply to the oath; the clause «فأخذناهم» is conjoined to an implied clause, i.e.: they denied, so We seized them, with no grammatical position; and the clause «لعلهم يتضرعون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The clause «فلولا تضرعوا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the clause «جاءهم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), in the position of the genitive; «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ); «إذ» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تضرعوا»; and the clause «ولكن قست قلوبهم» is conjoined to the clause «تضرعوا», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: (فلما نسوا ما ذكروا به) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause «زَيَّن»; «لما» is a particle of necessity for necessity (ḥarf wujūb li-wujūb); the clause «إذا فرحوا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause «فرحوا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «بغتة» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause «فإذا هم مبلسون» is conjoined to the apodosis clause «أخذناهم»; and «إذا» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya).

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The clause «فقُطع دابر» is conjoined to the clause ﴿هُمْ مُبْلِسُونَ﴾, with no grammatical position, and the clause «والحمد لله» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: (قل أرأيتم إن أخذ الله سمعكم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, the following interrogative indicating it, i.e.: if He took your hearing, then tell me, what god would bring it to you? His saying «من إله»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is the second object of «أرأيتم», the first being omitted, i.e.: your hearing; «غير» is a naʿt (adjective) of «إله», and the clause «يأتيكم» is a second naʿt of «إله». The clause «انظر» is resumptive; the clause «نصرف» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «انظر», which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative; and the clause «ثم هم يصدفون» is conjoined to the clause «نصرِّف», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The kāf in «أرأيتكم» is a particle of address with no grammatical position. The clause «إن أتاكم» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: then tell me. The clause «هل يهلك إلا القوم» is the second object of «أرأيتكم», and the first object is omitted, its implied form being: the punishment of Allah. His saying «بغتة»: a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: «مبشرين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «المرسلين»; the conditional clause is conjoined to the resumptive clause «ما نرسل»; and the clause «فلا خوف عليهم» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). His saying «فلا خوف»: «لا» is negating, operating like «ليس», and the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The clause «والذين كذبوا ...» is conjoined to the clause ﴿فَمَنْ آمَنَ﴾, with no grammatical position; the clause «يمسهم العذاب» is the khabar (predicate) of the relative; and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «بما كانوا» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يمسهم».

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The clause «ولا أعلم» is conjoined to the clause «لا أقول»; the clause «إن أتبع» is resumptive within the scope of the speech; and the clause «أفلا تتفكرون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يحشروا» is the object of «يخافون», and the clause «ليس لهم ولي» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «يحشروا». The preposition phrase «من دونه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of «ولي», and the clause «لعلهم يتقون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The clause «يريدون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «يَدْعون», in the position of the accusative, and the clause «ما عليك شيء» is a second ḥāl of the wāw in «يدعون». The preposition phrase «من حسابهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of «شيء»; «شيء» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); likewise «من حسابك» is attached to a ḥāl of «شيء». Even though the ḥāl «من حسابك» precedes its notional governing word «عليهم», that is permitted, as in the reading: ﴿وَالسَّمَاوَاتُ مَطْوِيَّاتٌ بِيَمِينِهِ﴾. His saying «فتطردهم»: the fāʾ is causal, and the verb is accusative by «أن» concealed after the fāʾ; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding negation, i.e.: there is no calling to account, and so [no] driving away; and the clause «فتطردهم» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī).

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: His saying «وكذلك فتنا»: the wāw is resumptive, and the kāf is a noun meaning «مثل» (like), in the position of the accusative as a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); «ذا» is a demonstrative, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the implied form is: We tried some of them with a trial like that trial. The preposition phrase «ببعض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «بعض», and the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) «ليقولوا» is attached to «فتنا». The preposition phrase «من بيننا» is attached to a ḥāl of the pronoun in «عليهم», and the clause «منَّ الله» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate). His saying «بأعلم»: the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and «أعلم» is the khabar of «ليس»; the preposition phrase «بالشاكرين» is attached to «أعلم».

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: (وإذا جاءك الذين يؤمنون بآياتنا فقل سلام عليكم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] «إذا» is an adverbial conditional attached to (mutaʿalliq) the meaning of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «سلام» is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition phrase «عليكم» is attached to the khabar (predicate); beginning with an indefinite noun is permitted because it is a supplication. The clause «كتب» is resumptive, and the interpreted maṣdar «أنه من عمل» is a badal (substitute) of «الرحمة». «من» is conditional, mubtadaʾ; the preposition phrase «منكم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «عمل», and the preposition phrase «بجهالة» is attached to a ḥāl of the pronoun in «عمل». The fāʾ in «فأنه» is linking, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e.: obtains; the clause «فغفرانه حاصل» is the apodosis, in the position of the jussive, and the link with the conditional clause is implied, i.e.: for it.

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: His saying «وكذلك نفصّل»: the wāw is resumptive, the kāf is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) to it, i.e.: We set out the signs in detail with a detailing like that detailing; the clause «نفصل» is resumptive. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «ولتستبين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted after it, the implied form being: and so that their way may become clear, We have set them out in detail; the implied clause «وفَصَّلناها» is conjoined to the clause «نفصِّل», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن أعبد» is accusative by removal of the preposition («عن»). The preposition phrase «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied resumptive pronoun, i.e.: you call upon it, being other than Allah. The clause «قل» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «قد ضللت» is resumptive within the scope of the speech; the clause «وما أنا من المهتدين» is conjoined to the clause «ضللت».

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: The preposition phrase «من ربي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «بينة»; the clause «وكذَّبتم به» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), in the position of the accusative; the clause «ما عندي ما تستعجلون به» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and «ما» is a relative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «إن الحكم إلا لله» [Translator's note: the source leaves this statement incomplete], and «إنْ» is negating; the clause «يقصُّ» is a ḥāl of the Divine Name, in the position of the accusative; and the clause «وهو خير الفاصلين» is conjoined to the clause «يقص», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن عندي ما تستعجلون» is the fāʿil (agent) of «ثبت» (it were established); «ما» is the noun of «أن»; the clause «لقضي الأمر» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and the clause «والله أعلم بالظالمين» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: The clause «وعنده مفاتح» is conjoined to the clause ﴿وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ﴾, with no grammatical position. The clause «لا يعلمها إلا هو» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «مفاتح», in the position of the accusative, and the pronoun «هو» is the fāʿil (agent). The clause «ويعلم» is conjoined to the clause «وعنده مفاتح», in the position of the accusative. The clause «وما تسقط من ورقة» is conjoined to the clause «يعلم», in the position of the accusative, and «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida); the clause «يعلمها» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl of «ورقة», a ḥāl of an indefinite noun being permitted because it is preceded by a negation. His saying «إلا في كتاب»: «إلا» is for disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ), and the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: except that it is in a Book.

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: The clause «ثم إليه مرجعكم» is conjoined to the clause «يَبْعَثُكُمْ», and the clause «ثم ينبئكم» is conjoined to the clause «إليه مرجعكم».

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: «فوق»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «هو». The clause «يرسل» is conjoined to the single word «القاهر». «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive. The clause «وهم لا يفرطون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: «مولاهم الحق» are two naʿts (adjectives) of the Divine Name. «ألا» is a particle of opening, and the clause after it is resumptive. The clause «وهو أسرع» is conjoined to the clause «له الحكم».

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: «مَن» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «تدعونه» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of «ينجيكم»; the clause «لئن أنجيتنا ...» explains the supplication before it; the lām in «لئن» paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); and «إنْ» is conditional.

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: The clause «ثم أنتم تشركون» is conjoined to the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يبعث» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «القادر»; «شيعًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the kāf. «كيف»: an interrogative noun, ḥāl; the clause «نُصَرِّف» is the object of the looking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative; and the clause «لعلهم يفقهون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: The clause «وكذَّب» is resumptive, and the clause «وهو الحق» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: The clause «وسوف تعلمون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: «غيره» is a naʿt (adjective) of «حديث». His saying «وإمَّا ينسينك»: the wāw is a conjunction, «إن» is conditional and «ما» is redundant (zāʾida); the verb is an imperfect indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the nūn of emphasis, in the position of the jussive; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause is conjoined to the resumptive conditional clause ﴿وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ﴾.

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: The preposition phrase «من حسابهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «شيء», the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida) because it enters upon an indefinite noun and is preceded by a negation. His saying «ولكن ذكرى»: the wāw is a conjunction, «ولكن» is a particle of rectification (istidrāk), and «ذكرى» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: remind them with a reminding, and it is a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar); the clause is conjoined to the clause «ما على الذين.... شيء». The clause «لعلهم يتقون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: The two objects of «اتخذوا» are «دينهم» and «لعبًا». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تبسل» is mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: for fear [that]; «ما» in His saying «بما كسبت» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تبسل». The clause «ليس لها ولي» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «نفس». The clause «وإن تعدل» is conjoined to the clause «ليس لها ولي», in the position of the nominative, and the clause «لهم شراب» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: «إذ» is an adverbial noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). His saying «كالذي»: the kāf is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: we would be turned back with a turning back like that of the one who …; the preposition phrase «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of «استهوته»; «حيران» is a ḥāl of the hāʾ of «استهوته»; the clause «له أصحاب» is a ḥāl of the pronoun in «حيران»; the clause «ائتنا» is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb of saying, and the implied verb is a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) pronoun in «يدعونه», i.e.: saying. His saying «وأمرنا لنسلم»: what the verb «أُمِرْنا» is attached to is implied, i.e.: and we have been commanded to sincerity.

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن أقيموا» is conjoined to the implied complement of «أُمِرْنا», i.e.: and we have been commanded to sincerity and to establishing prayer; and the clause «وهو الذي» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: The preposition phrase «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «خلق». «ويوم»: the wāw is a conjunction, and «يوم» is an adverb attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «قوله». The clause «وقوله الحق يوم يقول» is conjoined to the clause «خلق», and «الحق» is a naʿt (adjective). «كن فيكون»: [«كن» is] a complete (tāmm) imperative verb, its fāʿil being the pronoun «أنت»; the fāʾ is resumptive; «يكون» is a complete imperfect verb, its fāʿil being the pronoun «هو»; and the clause «فيكون» is resumptive. «يوم ينفخ» is an adverb attached to a ḥāl of «الملك». «عالم»: khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: He is the Knower; and the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: «وإذ»: the wāw is resumptive, and «إذ» is an adverbial noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied «اذكر» (remember); «آزر» is a badal (substitute). The two objects of «تتخذ» are «أصنامًا» and «آلهة». «قومك» is a noun conjoined to the kāf in «أراك»; the preposition phrase «في ضلال» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «قومك»; and the clause «إني أراك» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: «وكذلك»: the wāw is resumptive, and the kāf is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: We show Abraham a showing like that showing. The past of «نُري» is «أرينا»; the hamza of transfer (hamzat al-naql) has made the verb acquire a second object, and its two objects are «إبراهيمَ» and «ملكوتَ». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «ليكون» is genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) something implied, i.e.: We showed him that so that he might be; and the implied clause «أريناه» is conjoined to the resumptive one, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: The clause «فلما جنَّ عليه الليل» is conjoined to the clause ﴿نُرِي﴾, with no grammatical position, and «لما» is a particle of necessity for necessity (ḥarf wujūb li-wujūb).

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: «بازغًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the lām in «لئن» paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); and «إن» is conditional. The preposition phrase «من القوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «أكون».

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: The clause «هذا أكبر» is a badal (substitute) of the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative. «يا قوم»: the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative by the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the dropped yāʾ, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: «حنيفًا»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the tāʾ in «وجَّهت». The clause «وما أنا من المشركين» is conjoined to the clause «إني وجَّهْتُ», with no grammatical position, and «ما» is negating, operating like «ليس».

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: «أتحاجُّوني»: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the second nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya); and the yāʾ is an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The yāʾ dropped in writing from «هداني» is mafʿūl bihi, and the clause «وقد هداني» is a ḥāl (circumstantial). «إلا» is a particle of exception, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is a connected excepted (mustathnā muttaṣil), i.e.: except in the state of my Lord's willing, i.e.: I do not fear in any state except this state. The clause «وسع ربي» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause «تتذكرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: «كيف» is an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial), and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أنكم أشركتم» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The preposition phrase «عليكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of «سلطانًا». The clause «فأيُّ الفريقين أحق» is resumptive; the interrogative noun is mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أحق» is its khabar (predicate). The clause «إن كنتم تعلمون» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it.

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: The clause «أولئك لهم الأمن» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين»; the clause «لهم الأمن» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «أولئك»; and the clause «وهم مهتدون» is conjoined to the clause «لهم الأمن».

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: The clause «آتيناها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «حجتنا», in the position of the accusative; the clause «نرفع» is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «درجات» is the second object of «نرفع», and the first is «مَن»; the verb «نرفع» carries the meaning of «نُبَلِّغ» (We make reach).

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: «كُلا» is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and likewise «ونوحًا». His saying «ومن ذريته داود»: this preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «هدينا», implied, and «داود» is the object of this implied [verb]; the following names are conjoined to «داود». The clause «وكذلك نجزي» is parenthetical between the conjoined items, the wāw being parenthetical, and the kāf is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: We reward the doers of good with a reward like that reward. The first clause «هدينا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «إسحاق» and «يعقوب», i.e.: both guided; and the implied clause «هدينا» is conjoined to the second «هدينا», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: «زكريا» is a noun conjoined to «هارون», and likewise what follows it; «كل» is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «كل من الصالحين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the preceding names; and the tanwīn in «كل» is in compensation for an implied muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: His saying «ومن آبائهم»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied verb, its implied form being «هدينا»; the implied clause «هدينا» is conjoined to the clause ﴿فَضَّلْنَا﴾ in the previous verse.

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: The preposition phrase «من عباده» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «مَن»; the clause «يهدي» is a ḥāl of «هدى الله»; the clause «ولو أشركوا» is conjoined to «ذلك هدى الله», with no grammatical position; and the clause «لحبط ما كانوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: The clause «فإن يكفر بها هؤلاء» is conjoined to the clause «أولئك الذين». His saying «بكافرين»: the khabar (predicate) of «ليس», and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida); the preposition phrase «بها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar; and the clause «ليسوا بكافرين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قومًا».

harrat-mujtaba:90-90.t: «أولئك الذين» are mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). The clause «فبهداهم اقتده» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «أولئك الذين هدى الله»; the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «اقتده», and the verb is an imperative indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, the hāʾ being for the pause (hāʾ al-sakt). The preposition phrase «عليه» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أجرًا». His saying «إن هو إلا ذكرى للعالمين»: «إنْ» is negating; [then come] mubtadaʾ and khabar; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); the preposition phrase is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «ذكرى»; and the clause is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:91-91.t: (وما قدروا الله حق قدره) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] «حق»: a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the original being «قَدْره الحق» (its true measure); the adverb «إذ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قدروا»; «مِن» in His saying «من شيء» is redundant (zāʾida), and «شيء» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «مَنْ» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «أنزل» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate); «نورًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «به»; the clause «تجعلونه» is a ḥāl of «الكتاب»; the clause «تبدونها» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «قراطيس»; the clause «وعُلِّمتم» is a ḥāl of the wāw in «تخفون»; His saying «أنتم»: tawkīd (emphasis) of the agent pronoun in «تعلموا»; and «آباؤكم» is a noun conjoined to the wāw in «تعلموا». The Divine Name is the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb, i.e.: Allah sent it down. The clause «ثم ذرهم» is conjoined to the clause «قل», with no grammatical position, and the clause «يلعبون» is a ḥāl of the object pronoun in «ذرهم».

harrat-mujtaba:92-92.t: «مبارك مصدق» are two naʿts (adjectives) of «كتاب», and the relative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the annexation of «مصدق» is not pure (ghayr maḥḍa), so it is indefinite. The clause «أنزلناه» is a naʿt of «كتاب», in the position of the nominative. His saying «ولتنذر»: the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to something implied, i.e.: We sent it down so that they may believe and so that you may warn; the relative «مَن» is conjoined to «أمّ»; and the clause «وهم يحافظون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «يؤمنون».

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: The clause «ومن أظلم» is resumptive; «من» is mubtadaʾ (subject) and «أظلم» is its khabar (predicate). The preposition and its genitive noun «إليَّ» are the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause «ولم يوح إليه شيء» is a ḥāl (circumstantial). His saying «ومن»: a relative noun conjoined to the «مَن» made genitive by «مِن»; «مثل» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «ولو ترى» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e.: you would see a terrible thing. The adverb «إذا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ترى»; «الظالمون» is mubtadaʾ, and the preposition phrase «في غمرات» is attached to the khabar; the clause «الظالمون في غمرات الموت» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). [Translator's note: so in the source, «إذا»; the verse has «إذ».] The clause «والملائكة باسطو أيديهم» is a ḥāl, and «أيديهم» is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause «أخرجوا» is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied verb of saying, and the implied clause of saying is a ḥāl of the pronoun in «باسطو», i.e.: saying. The adverb «اليوم» is attached to the verb «تجزون»; the clause «تجزون» is resumptive; «عذاب» is the second object; and «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive, attached to «تجزون».

harrat-mujtaba:94-94.t: His saying «جئتمونا»: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent), the mīm is for the plural, and the wāw is for lengthening (al-ishbāʿ). «فرادى» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw; the kāf in «كما» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya, the maṣdar (verbal noun) being muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e.: a coming like your coming on the day …. «أول» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خلقناكم»; the clause «وتركتم» is a ḥāl of the kāf in «خلقناكم»; the clause «وما نرى» is conjoined to the clause «تركتم», in the position of the accusative; the relative «الذين زعمتم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «شفعاءكم»; the maṣdar «أنهم فيكم شركاء» stands in place of the two objects of «زعم»; the fāʿil of «تقطَّع» is a latent pronoun, its implied form being «هو», referring back to the connection understood from the context; and the two objects of «تزعمون» are omitted, i.e.: you claim them to be partners.

harrat-mujtaba:95-95.t: The clause «يخرج» is a second khabar (predicate) of «إن», and His saying «ومخرج» is a noun conjoined to «فالق». His saying «ذلكم الله»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar. The clause «فأنى تؤفكون» is resumptive, and «أنى» is an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:96-96.t: «فالق» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being «هو», and the clause is resumptive; the clause «وجعل» is conjoined to the resumptive one, with no grammatical position. His saying «والشمس والقمر حسبانًا»: «الشمس» is conjoined to «الليل», and «حسبانًا» is a noun conjoined to «سكنًا».

harrat-mujtaba:97-97.t: The clause «قد فصَّلنا» is resumptive, and the clause «يعلمون» is in the position of the genitive as naʿt (adjective) of «قوم».

harrat-mujtaba:98-98.t: «فمستقر»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «مستقر» is mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e.: of you. The clause «فمنكم مستقر» is conjoined to the clause «أنشأكم», with no grammatical position. The clause «قد فصَّلنا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:99-99.t: The clause «فأخرجنا» is conjoined to the clause «أنزل», with no grammatical position; the clause «نخرج» is a naʿt (adjective) of «خضرا», in the position of the accusative. His saying «ومن النخل من طلعها قنوان»: the wāw is a conjunction; the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «قنوان»; and the second preposition phrase is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) of the first. The clause «ومن النخل قنوان» is a nominal clause conjoined to the clause «نخرج», in the position of the accusative, so the pronoun in the conjoined clause is implied, i.e.: clusters from it. The preposition phrase «من أعناب» is attached to a naʿt of «جنات»; His saying «والزيتون» is conjoined to «جنات»; His saying «مشتبها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الرمان»; His saying «غير» is conjoined to «مشتبها»; the clause «انظروا» is resumptive; «إذا» is a pure adverb attached to «انظروا»; and the clause «أثمر» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:100-100.t: The two objects of «جعل» are «شركاء» and «الجن». The clause «وخلقهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «جعلوا». The implied clause «نسبح سبحانه» is resumptive, and the clause «وتعالى» is conjoined to the implied «نسبح»; «سبحانه» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «ما» in «عمَّا» is maṣdariyya, and the genitive interpreted maṣdar is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied «نسبّح».

harrat-mujtaba:101-101.t: «بديع» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: He is the Originator. His saying «أنى يكون له ولد»: [«أنى» is] an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial); [«يكون» is] an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb; «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of «يكون»; and «ولد» is the noun of «يكون». The clause «ولم تكن له صاحبة» is a ḥāl of the hāʾ in «له»; the clause «وخلق» is conjoined to the ḥāl clause; and the clause «وهو عليم» is conjoined to the clause «خلق».

harrat-mujtaba:102-102.t: «ربكم» is a second khabar (predicate); the pronoun «هو» is a badal (substitute) of the latent pronoun in the omitted khabar; the clause of declaring [Allah] free of partners (al-tanzīh) is a third khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «ذلكم»; and «خالق» is a fourth khabar. The clause «فاعبدوه» is conjoined to the clause «ذلكم الله», and the clause «وهو على كل شيء وكيل» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:103-103.t: The clause «لا تدركه الأبصار» is a second khabar (predicate) of the detached pronoun «هو»; the clause «وهو يدرك» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «تدركه»; and the clause «وهو اللطيف» is conjoined to the clause «وهو يدرك».

harrat-mujtaba:104-104.t: The clause «فمن أبصر» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «جاءكم», with no grammatical position, and the clause «أبصر» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate). His saying «فلنفسه»: the fāʾ links to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: his seeing is for himself; likewise His saying «فعليها», i.e.: his blindness is against it. The clause «وما أنا بحفيظ» is conjoined to the clause «جاءكم», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:105-105.t: (وكذلك نصرف الآيات) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is resumptive, and the kāf is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: We vary the signs with a varying like that varying. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «ليقولوا» is genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) something implied, i.e.: and We vary them so that they say; and the maṣdar «ولنبينه» is genitive, conjoined to the preceding maṣdar «ليقولوا».

harrat-mujtaba:106-106.t: The preposition phrase «من ربك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما»; the clause of declaring [Allah] free of partners (al-tanzīh) is parenthetical between the conjoined items; and the clause «أعرض» is conjoined to the clause «اتبع», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:107-107.t: The clause «وما جعلناك» is resumptive, and the clause «وما أنت بوكيل» is conjoined to the clause «جعلناك»; «ما» is Ḥijāzī, operating like «ليس», and the bāʾ in its khabar (predicate) is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:108-108.t: His saying «فيسبُّوا الله»: accusative by «أن» concealed after the causal fāʾ, and the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: let there be no reviling of their gods from you, and so a reviling of Allah from them. «عَدْوًا» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because «العَدْو» carries the meaning of reviling; the preposition phrase «بغير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «يسبُّوا»; and the kāf in «كذلك» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e.: We have made fair-seeming with a making-fair like that making-fair. The clause «ثم إلى ربهم مرجعهم» is conjoined to an implied verb, i.e.: so they did it; then to their Lord is their return; and the clause «فينبئهم» is conjoined to the clause «إلى ربهم مرجعهم», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:109-109.t: «جَهْد» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: they swore a strenuous swearing. The clause «لئن جاءتهم آية» explains the swearing. His saying «ليؤمنن»: the lām occurs in the reply to the oath, and the imperfect verb is nominative by the retention of the nūn, which has been dropped because of a succession of like letters; the plural wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescents, is the fāʿil (agent); and the nūn is for emphasis. His saying «وما يشعركم»: the wāw is a conjunction; «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the fāʿil of «يشعركم» is a latent pronoun, its implied form being «هو», and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause «يشعركم» is the khabar (predicate). The interpreted maṣdar «أنها إذا جاءت» is the second object of «يشعركم»; «إذا» is a pure adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يؤمنون»; and the clause «لا يؤمنون» is the khabar of «إنَّ».

harrat-mujtaba:110-110.t: The clause «ونُقَلِّب» is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the kāf in «كما» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya, i.e.: a turning about like their not believing; «أول» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يؤمنوا»; and the clause «يعمهون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of «نذرهم».

harrat-mujtaba:111-111.t: (ولو أننا نزلنا إليهم الملائكة) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The interpreted maṣdar from «أنَّ» and what follows it is the fāʿil (agent) of an implied «ثبت» (it were established). «قبلا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «كل», even though it [«كل»] is indefinite, because of its annexation; «كل» has gained specification (takhṣīṣ) from this annexation. The lām in «ليؤمنوا»: [the verb is] accusative by «أن» necessarily concealed after the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd), which is the one preceded by a negated «كان»; and the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied khabar (predicate), i.e.: intending faith. The maṣdar «أن يشاء» is accusative by connected exception (al-istithnāʾ al-muttaṣil), i.e.: they would not believe in any state except the state of Allah's willing. The clause «ولكن أكثرهم يجهلون» is conjoined to the resumptive clause at the beginning of the verse.

harrat-mujtaba:112-112.t: The kāf in «كذلك» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: We made a making like that; the preposition phrase «لكل نبي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «عدوا»; the two objects of «جعل» are «شياطين» and «عدوا»; the clause «يوحي» is a ḥāl of «شياطين الإنس»; «غرورا» is mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); and the conditional clause is conjoined to the resumptive «جعلنا». The clause «فذرهم» is resumptive, and «ما» is a relative conjoined to the hāʾ in «ذرهم».

harrat-mujtaba:113-113.t: His saying «ولتصغى»: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is for causation, and the verb is accusative by a concealed «أن»; the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يوحي» in the previous verse, and this maṣdar is conjoined to «غرورا», i.e.: some of them inspire others for delusion and for inclining. The first mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) fulfils the conditions for the accusative, while the second fails them in that the agent is not the same in it: the agent of the inspiring is «بعضهم», and the agent of the inclining is the hearts. The maṣdar «ليرضوه» is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar.

harrat-mujtaba:114-114.t: (أفغير الله أبتغي حكما) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The hamza is for the interrogative, and the fāʾ conjoins to something implied, i.e.: say to them: shall I incline to them and seek …; «غير» is a fronted object of «أبتغي», and «حكما» is tamyīz (specification). His saying «أأميل إليهم» is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl) of a resumptive clause whose implied form is: say to them. The clause «وهو الذي» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the Divine Name, in the position of the accusative; the relative clause is resumptive; and the clause «فلا تكونن» is conjoined to the clause «الذين آتيناهم يعلمون».
